title: Enterprise Architect
description:
Remote

Must follow and support US time zones

Enterprise Architect


Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, Economics, Sociology, or another related field.
  • 8+ years of IT experience required.
  • 4+ years of architecture experience in multiple architectural domains such as business, information, application, integration, technology, and security.
  • Ability to make decisions and recommendations on technology strategies while considering various options and business needs.
  • Awareness of retail, supply chain, manufacturing, or consumer goods industries.
  • TOGAF, IASA or any other architecture-related certification is required.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities


The Technical Architect provides the leadership, facilitation, analysis, and design tasks required for the development of an enterprise's technical architecture. They create deliverables that help develop target-state guidance (standards, guidelines, reference implementations) for evolving the technical infrastructure across the enterprise, to enable business strategy and deliver targeted business outcomes. They facilitate and orchestrate the delivery of targeted business outcomes through technical decisions.


  • Leads efforts to develop and maintain the architectural assets for the technical domain.
  • Sets an architecture direction for the technical domain that is aligned with business and IT goals.
  • Works with service management teams and solution architects to lower the total cost of ownership for IT capabilities.
  • Represents enterprise architecture by advocating and sharing knowledge.
  • Participates as a member of one or more architectural review boards (ARB) that ensure architecture quality and compliance.


  • Integration Architecture
  • Application Architecture
  • Technical Architecture
  • New Technology Innovation
  • Architecture Work
  • Modeling & Design:


Standard Setting:

  • Leads the creation of technical standards within area(s) of responsibility
  • Responsible for updating work products and communication when changes are required

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Inviting Senior Editors of EI Compendex Journals
description:
We are a seasoned academic service team dedicated to advancing international scholarly exchange and collaboration. To better support researchers worldwide in disseminating their work, we are now seeking experienced professionals like you—with a background as an editor or special issue organizer for EI Compendex-indexed journals —to join our expert team and contribute to elevating the quality and impact of academic papers.


We Are Looking For Candidates with the Following Profile:

  • A strong academic research background and a respected reputation in your field.
  • Must possess one of the following senior-level experiences:
  • Must currently be organizing and guest-editing a Special Issue for an EI Compendex-indexed journal.
  • Must currently be serving as an editor, associate editor, or editorial board member for an EI Compendex-indexed journal.


Your Role Will Include (Clear Academic Support Services):

  • Academic Review & Deep Polishing: Evaluate manuscripts for scientific rigor, logic, and originality, while refining academic expression, flow, and terminology to meet international publication standards.
  • Professional Translation & Grammar Polishing: Accurately translate Chinese research papers into natural, fluent academic English, ensuring correctness in grammar, spelling, and sentence structure.
  • Figure Optimization: Ensure all figures, charts, and images in the manuscript comply with the technical requirements of target journals, including but not limited to: format, layout, resolution (DPI), color mode, and file size.
  • Cover Letter Drafting: Assist authors in concisely summarizing the manuscript’s core strengths, innovations, and academic value in a compelling cover letter , enhancing its initial impression on journal editors.
  • Submission Assistance: Based on the article’s specific content, academic quality, and research field, recommend suitable journals indexed in the EI Compendex database for the author’s reference and selection.


Our Commitment and Emphasis (Core Compliance):

  • Full Compliance: All services we provide are strictly for “academic support” and absolutely do not involve any form of ghostwriting, data fabrication, or plagiarism . Your work will focus solely on improving the quality of the author’s original manuscript, with all final decisions remaining with the author.
  • No Acceptance Guarantee: We do not and cannot guarantee that any manuscript will be accepted. The final decision on publication rests entirely with the journal’s editors and peer-review process. Submission assistance is solely a recommendation based on content and does not imply any outcome.
  • Respect for Academic Integrity: We strictly adhere to publishing ethics standards (e.g., COPE guidelines). Our services are designed to help authors overcome language, presentation, and technical barriers, not to replace their core research work.


By Joining Us, You Will Receive:

  • Competitive remuneration and flexible working hours that fully respect your academic schedule.
  • Opportunities to engage with cutting-edge research and exchange ideas with outstanding global scholars.
  • The professional satisfaction of contributing to clearer, more standardized, and influential scientific communication.

If our mission resonates with you, and you wish to leverage your senior experience to help more scholars share their work globally, we sincerely invite you to get in touch.


We look forward to partnering with you in upholding the beacon of academic excellence!

title: Analista Planejamento Agrícola Sr
description:
Que desafio temos para você?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Planejamento Agrícola Sr para atuar no time de Tratos Culturais.


Quais as responsabilidades?

Planejar o preparo e plantio corporativo;

Acompanhar indicadores chave;

Utilizar modelo financeiro para definição de reforma;

Elaborar estudos estratégicos para otimização do planejamento de preparo e plantio;

Construir relatórios gerenciais.


Quais os requisitos?

Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia Agronômica, de Produção ou correlatas;

Necessário sólida experiência em Planejamento Agrícola;

Domínio do pacote office – Excel, Power Point e Power BI;

Residir em São José do Rio Preto/SP.


Qual localidade?

São José do Rio Preto/SP.


O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.


Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.


Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Security Researcher (GReAT)
description:
Established in 2008, Global Research & Analysis Team (GReAT) operates at the very heart of Kaspersky, uncovering APTs, cyber-espionage campaigns, major malware, ransomware, and underground cyber-criminal trends across the world. Today GReAT consists of 40+ experts working globally – in Europe, Russia, Americas, Asia, Middle East. Talented security professionals provide company leadership in anti-malware research and innovation, bringing unrivaled expertise, passion and curiosity to the discovery and analysis of cyberthreats.


Rights / Responsibilities:

  • Monitor, analyze and understand malware trends at local, regional and global level
  • Content creation: Analyze and describe ongoing APT and Crimeware campaigns worldwide
  • Enhance the Threat Intelligence products developed by Kaspersky
  • Present about IT security to wide audiences (cybersecurity community, customers, journalists, etc...)
  • Give interviews about various cybersecurity trends and topics
  • Suggest ideas to be implemented in company’s products
  • Prototype development: imagine and develop prototypes or new technologies
  • Take an active part in the formation of requirements for the internal infrastructure of Kaspersky
  • Participate in the development of the unit's recommended practices and standards, assume responsibility for accomplishing group goals
  • Ensure a proper level of information security, including any devices that are used to work with company's infrastructure


Specialist knowledge:

  • Excellent written and spoken English
  • Ability to analyze and understand malicious code (Windows PE, .Net, OLE2, JS, VBS, HTML, PDF, SWF, ELF)
  • Good knowledge of Intel x86 assembler
  • Ability to use IDA or Ghidra for reverse engineering
  • Good knowledge of WinAPI
  • Basic knowledge of Linux API / kernel / POSIX
  • Excellent knowledge of Windows PE file format
  • Good experience in using at least one of following programming languages: C/C++/C#/Java/Python/Go/Rust
  • Knowledge of the operating principles of TCP/IP sockets
  • Technical article writing skills
  • Understanding of modern Threat Landscape as well as Threat Intelligence industry

title: Desenvolvedor FullStack Sênior
description:
Sobre a THREAD


A THREAD é uma consultoria de tecnologia e engenharia de software que cresce de forma consistente, impulsionada pela entrega contínua de valor e pela confiança de grandes marcas.


Somos especialistas em desenvolver sistemas sob medida, projetados para unir estratégia, dados e performance em cada solução.


Atuamos em parceria com empresas de diversos setores corporativos entregando produtos digitais, integrações e plataformas que conectam tecnologia à estratégia de negócio.


Descrição da vaga


Buscamos um Desenvolvedor FullStack Sênior para atuar 100% remoto em uma squad de sustentação e evolução de produtos digitais de um cliente do setor financeiro e automotivo.


Você será responsável por sustentar, evoluir e melhorar continuamente sistemas críticos, tanto no back-end quanto no front-end. Esperamos alguém com maturidade, autonomia e capacidade real de diagnóstico e entrega: o tipo de profissional que eleva o nível do time.


Responsabilidades


  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir serviços back-end em Node.js (TypeScript).
  • Criar e manter testes automatizados usando Jest, com abordagem TDD/BDD.
  • Realizar testes integrados e de infraestrutura usando Testcontainers.
  • Desenvolver interfaces com React.js e Next.js quando necessário.
  • Trabalhar com bancos SQL e NoSQL: MySQL, PostgreSQL e MongoDB.
  • Integrar e otimizar estruturas de Elasticsearch e Redis.
  • Criar e manter ambientes de desenvolvimento usando Docker.
  • Atuar em investigações profundas (debugging avançado) de problemas em produção.
  • Colaborar com backend, frontend, produto, QA e operações em demandas críticas.
  • Entregar soluções com foco em estabilidade, segurança, performance e clareza.


Requisitos Obrigatórios


Back-end


  • Node.js com TypeScript nível sênior
  • Jest com domínio de BDD/TDD
  • Testcontainers para testes integrados
  • Experiência avançada com Docker
  • Integração e otimização com Elasticsearch
  • Cache e mensageria com Redis
  • Domínio de bancos relacionais MySQL e PostgreSQL
  • Experiência com MongoDB


Front-end


  • React.JS nível sênior
  • Next.JS nível avançado
  • Boas práticas de arquitetura front-end
  • Integração com APIs REST e GraphQL (se aplicável)


Outros requisitos essenciais


  • Git avançado
  • Capacidade de lidar com código legado, refatorar e organizar bases existentes
  • Escrita técnica consistente e clara
  • Autonomia forte para diagnóstico e solução de problemas complexos
  • Visão sistêmica e foco em impacto
  • Experiência sólida com code review estruturado, apontando melhorias e garantindo padrões técnicos


Diferenciais (não obrigatórios, mas valorizados)


  • Experiência com React Native
  • Kotlin (Spring Boot, Korg, Kotest, Testcontainers)
  • Vivência com arquitetura de microsserviços

title: SAP SAC Developer
description:
Required Skills & Experience


- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent experience. - 5+ years of experience in SAP Analytics Cloud with a strong focus on Planning. - Proven track record in SAC Planning model design, data actions, and advanced formulas. - Hands-on experience with integration to SAP ERP systems. - Strong understanding of financial planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes. - Proficiency in data modeling, scripting, and performance tuning within SAC. - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


- Experience with predictive planning and advanced analytics in SAC. - Familiarity with cloud architecture and security best practices.


Job Description


One of Insight Global's clients is seeking a skilled SAP SAC Developer to lead and support Reporting & Analytics initiatives. This role involves designing and developing SAC planning models, managing data processes, and collaborating with international business stakeholders to enhance decision-making capabilities. The role is fully remote, 4:30pm - 12:30am IST (6:00am - 1:00pm EST). Responsibilities: - Design and develop SAC Planning models, including dimensions, hierarchies, and data actions. - Configure planning workflows, allocations, and predictive forecasting within SAC. - Integrate SAC with SAP S/4HANA and other relevant data sources for seamless planning and reporting. - Collaborate with business users to map processes, identify improvements, and document solutions. - Lead and manage small-scale projects or segments of larger initiatives using standard methodologies. - Monitor and troubleshoot data loads, ensuring system reliability and performance. - Develop stories, dashboards, and visualizations to support planning and analytics. - Provide technical guidance and best practices for SAC Planning implementation.

title: Enterprise Support Engineer
description:
About HotMic


HotMic builds AI-powered video creation workflows that help creators and media teams produce high-quality content faster and more efficiently. We operate our own platform and also work closely with large enterprise customers to deliver custom, high-impact solutions.



Role Overview


We are hiring a Senior Enterprise Support Engineer to work directly with one major enterprise customer. This is a hands-on role involving both full-stack JavaScript development and customer-facing support. You will gather requirements, develop and ship customer-specific features, resolve issues, and keep the customer updated through calls and messages. You’ll also participate in our regular engineering sprints alongside other developers and product staff.



Responsibilities


  • Develop and deliver features tailored to a large enterprise customer.
  • Provide technical support, troubleshooting, and issue resolution.
  • Communicate directly with the customer via calls and messages.
  • Work within engineering sprints and coordinate with internal teams.
  • Maintain clear, fluent English communication.



Requirements


  • Fluent English (spoken and written).
  • Senior-level full-stack JavaScript experience.
  • Experience working in structured team sprints.
  • Background working with enterprise customers or complex implementations.
  • Comfortable in a mixed engineering + support role.
  • Strong teamwork and ability to work independently.

title: Senior Software Engineer (JavaScript / RoR)
description:
Senior Software Engineer (JavaScript / RoR)We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience using Ruby on Rails to join as a core member of our U.S. client's tight-knit, experienced engineering team. In this role, you will play a leadership role as well as actively contribute to strategizing and building at the feature level rather than just focusing on outputs.

Our client is a venture capital-backed health tech company transforming the industry's coding practices by creating a marketplace that connects healthcare companies with over 4,000 certified coding specialists. The client is focused on expanding quickly its product, engineering, and design teams with passionate builders who thrive in a fast-paced environment to support its rapid growth.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with engineering and product stakeholders to define, design, and build new features and integrations
  • Advance software platform capabilities using Ruby on Rails
  • Develop and support third-party integrations with B2B healthcare systems
  • Provide work estimates for bug fixes, enhancements, and features
  • Deliver high-quality, well-documented code with velocity
  • Mentor junior engineers and aid the engineering team with troubleshooting
  • Write and execute unit tests
  • Promote development best practices following team standards with an eye towards innovation and opportunities to scale
  • Work independently with minimal need for oversight and a bias towards action as well as display a willingness to ask questions when needed to remain efficient
  • Become energized by tackling new challenges and eagerly give and receive feedback from colleagues


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience using Ruby on Rails, including version 7+, with a strong background in JavaScript and frameworks (preferably Stimulus)
  • Experience taking the lead on complete features, appropriate to your level, and showing initiative to solve ambiguous problems
  • Experience creating and consuming APIs
  • Knowledge of relational / non-relational database systems
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience (optimally a technical or engineering degree)
  • Experience in healthcare, healthtech industry, or growth stage startups
  • Experience with Stimulus, Turbo, Tailwind, Sidekiq, or Heroku Shield


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Analista Contábil
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Contábil para se juntar à nossa equipe em nosso escritório de contabilidade localizado no Centro de Curitiba - PR. Procuramos um(a) profissional com experiência pratica e visão analítica, que domine os processos contábeis do dia a dia e tenha interesse em desenvolver competências também na área fiscal (diferencial).

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

Como será o seu dia a dia:

  • Classificação e conciliação contábil;
  • Fechamento contábil mensal e anual;
  • Elaboração das Demonstrações Contábeis (Balanço, DRE, DFC, DMPL, DLPA, Notas Explicativas);
  • Entrega de obrigações acessórias: ECD, ECF e demais exigências do regime adotado;
  • Contribuir com relatórios gerenciais e análises financeiras para suporte à gestão;
  • Apoiar em decisões estratégicas com base em dados contábeis e financeiros;
  • Atendimento aos clientes da carteira;
  • Atuar de forma integrada com o time fiscal, com abertura para desenvolver habilidades na área.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

O que buscamos:

  • Profissional graduado em Ciências Contábeis;
  • Experiência anterior na área contábil;
  • Domínio em fechamento contábil;
  • Desejável conhecimento em apuração fiscal;
  • Perfil analítico, proativo e colaborativo.

Competências Comportamentais:

  • Comunicação;
  • Espírito de equipe;
  • Trabalho em equipe;
  • Resiliência;

Desejável:

Experiência prática em escritório de contabilidade.


DIFERENCIAIS


  • Vivência em ambientes contábeis de empresas de médio porte ou escritórios;
  • Conhecimento em Domínio Sistemas;
  • Interessados em aprendizado e desenvolvimento técnico.


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Benefícios:

  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Plano Dental;
  • Vale Alimentação/Vale Refeição de R$ 31,00 por dia (cartão Flash);
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Ajusta de Custo de R$ 200,00;
  • Day off (folga no dia do seu aniversário).

Remuneração:

A combinar de acordo com a experiência.

Tipo de vaga:

Tempo integral em horário comercial de segunda à sexta, Efetivo CLT/PJ.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Desenvolvedor(a) Full stack — Golang (Híbrido, São Paulo)


Estamos em busca de um(a) desenvolvedor(a) full stack apaixonado(a) por tecnologia e interessado(a) em construir produtos inovadores com impacto real na vida social das pessoas.


A vaga é híbrida, com encontros presenciais quinzenais em São Paulo , e faz parte de uma startup de IA em rápido crescimento que atua na interseção entre tecnologia e experiências sociais.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter sistemas backend de alta performance e escalabilidade.
  • Auxiliar em tarefas pontuais de frontend
  • Integrar serviços baseados em IA e infraestrutura em nuvem.
  • Colaborar com o time de produto e engenharia em um ambiente dinâmico e criativo.
  • Participar de decisões técnicas sobre arquitetura e stack.

Requisitos principais

  • Golang — experiência sólida e comprovada.
  • Python — bom domínio, especialmente para scripts e integração com modelos de IA.
  • AWS — familiaridade com serviços essenciais de infraestrutura (EC2, S3, Lambda, etc).
  • React (puro)
  • TypeScript

Diferenciais (Good to Have)

  • Conhecimento em modelos de linguagem (LLMs) e aplicações de IA generativa.
  • Experiência com sistemas distribuídos ou arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.

Sobre nós


A Point é uma startup de tecnologia baseada em São Paulo que ajuda jovens a descobrirem, em tempo real, onde estão os melhores rolês da cidade – de festas e shows a eventos culturais e experiências diferentes. Nosso produto combina um mapa vivo da cidade com uma assistente conversacional, a Nina , que organiza milhares de eventos a partir de fontes como Instagram, Google Maps e plataformas de ingressos.


Trabalhamos com dados de forma responsável para entender contexto, comportamento e preferências, sempre com foco em privacidade e em entregar recomendações relevantes de verdade para quem quer sair de casa. Estamos em fase early-stage, crescendo rápido, testando hipóteses o tempo todo e muito perto da cena cultural de São Paulo.


No dia a dia, somos um time enxuto, hands-on e colaborativo. Valorizamos autonomia, clareza, feedback direto e gente que gosta de construir do zero, assumir responsabilidade e aprender rápido. Se você curte cidade grande, tecnologia, cultura, música e quer participar da construção de um produto novo para a vida noturna e cultural de SP, a Point é um bom lugar pra você.

title: Insights Analyst
description:
Insights Analyst


Company Overview:

Foster & Flow is a consulting company dedicated to developing customized business answers that unlock value from consumer behavior through data science and analytics. We work with top brands to provide insights that drive growth and innovation.

Position:  Insights Analyst 

Location:  Remote


Key Responsibilities:

• Collaborate with a dynamic team working on projects for a leading global beverage company.

• Translate datasets into actionable insights about consumer behavior within the CPG (Consumer Packaged Goods) industry.

• Use advanced Excel skills to manage, clean, and analyze data efficiently.

• Develop clear, compelling presentations and analytical reports in PowerPoint to communicate findings and support decision-making.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams on research, market intelligence, and ad-hoc analytical initiatives.

• Build data-driven narratives and visualizations that enhance understanding and business impact.

• Develop reports and dashboards to visualize data findings.

title: Senior Clinical Data Science Programmer
description:
Senior Clinical Data Science Programmer - Remote - Brazil


ICON plc is a world-leading healthcare intelligence and clinical research organization. We’re proud to foster an inclusive environment driving innovation and excellence, and we welcome you to join us on our mission to shape the future of clinical development


We are currently seeking a Senior Clinical Data Science Programmer to join our diverse and dynamic team. As a Senior Clinical Data Science Programmer at ICON, you will play a pivotal role in developing and implementing programming solutions to support the analysis and reporting of clinical trial data. You will contribute to the advancement of innovative treatments and therapies by ensuring the accuracy and efficiency of data processing through your programming expertise.


What You Will Be Doing:

  • Develop, validate, and maintain programming solutions for CDMS (EDC systems such as Rave/Veeva), data validation outputs, data review/risk management outputs, custom reports, and programs in clinical trials.
  • Collaborate with data managers, project managers, clinical data scientists, and biostatisticians to ensure the integration of programming solutions into the overall data management process.
  • Act as a primary point of contact during the study set up and maintenance phase for system programming related questions by the project team.
  • Support colleagues with the clinical trials environment and concepts of Clinical Data Management Systems.
  • Perform extracts of data from CDMS and creation of data transfer programs.
  • Act as mentor and provides guidance and support to more junior programmer levels assigned to a project.
  • Assist in the development and implementation of improvements to technical systems and processes within an SME role.
  • Provide guidance on programming best practices, coding standards, and data quality control measures.
  • Stay updated on advancements in programming languages and data management tools to enhance operational efficiencies.


Your Profile:

  • Complete bachelor’s degree relevant field such as computer science, SAS, statistics, or life sciences.
  • Extensive experience in programming for CDMS (EDC systems such as Rave/Veeva), data validation outputs, data review/risk management outputs, custom reports, and programs in clinical trials with proficiency in languages such as SAS, R, or Python.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills, with a commitment to delivering high-quality results.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with diverse teams and influence outcomes.
  • MUST HAVE advanced English Communication, Writing and Reading

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Full Stack Developer – São Paulo

Employment Type: 1-Year Contract

Seniority Level: Associate

Industry: IT Services & Consulting / Technology / Information & Media

Role Overview

We’re looking for an experienced Full Stack Developer to build and maintain tools and infrastructure for UX workflows. This position combines hands-on engineering with strong cross-functional collaboration.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prototyping: Develop high-fidelity, interactive prototypes using Polygon Studio for user feedback.
  • Asset & Template Management: Create and maintain shared asset repositories and design templates.
  • Component Library Development: Build reusable UI components in Lit/React for efficiency and consistency.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Work closely with stakeholders, including design, sales, and operations teams, on requirements and project updates.
  • Technical Implementation: Ensure cross-browser compatibility, performance, and write clean, documented code.
  • Platform Expertise: Develop deep knowledge of the Polygon platform.
  • User Onboarding & Support: Provide support and guidance to new users on the Formats Infrastructure.
  • Advertisement Campaign Support: Collaborate with internal teams to design and implement advertising features/campaigns aligned with product goals.
  • Operations Enablement: Partner with operations teams to streamline deployment, process workflows, and performance monitoring of delivered solutions.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Minimum 5 years’ experience in Full Stack Development (mandatory).
  • Mandatory experience in Advertisement and Operations environments, with a proven ability to work cross-functionally to deliver integrated solutions.
  • Proficiency in front-end development (HTML, CSS/SASS, JavaScript/TypeScript).
  • Experience with modern web frameworks (e.g., Angular, React, Lit).
  • Skills in building responsive component libraries.
  • Ability to develop high-fidelity interactive prototypes.
  • Experience with design systems (e.g., Material UI).
  • Knowledge of version control and collaboration tools (e.g., Git).
  • Understanding of UX principles and user-centered design.
  • Experience with AngularJS applications (single-page, complex data-driven interfaces).
  • CSS proficiency (Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS, SASS, LESS).
  • Full stack development capabilities (Node.js, Python, Java, .NET).
  • Database knowledge (SQL, NoSQL).
  • Proven sales experience and ability to collaborate with sales teams to understand client needs and support solution selling.

title: Gen AI Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for "Gen AI Engineer" who wants to learn and transform his career


This role will focus on developing and implementing generative AI solutions to enhance nuclear operations, safety protocols, maintenance procedures, and operational efficiency. combine expertise in artificial intelligence and machine learning with an understanding of nuclear industry requirements to create transformative AI applications that support safe, reliable nuclear power generation.



Responsibility :


  • Design, develop, and deploy generative AI solutions tailored to nuclear operations, including large language models, document generation, and intelligent automation systems
  • Collaborate with nuclear engineers, operations personnel, and subject matter experts to identify opportunities for AI-driven improvements in safety, efficiency, and compliance
  • Build and fine-tune AI models for nuclear-specific applications such as procedure generation, technical documentation analysis, predictive maintenance, and operational decision support
  • Ensure all AI solutions comply with nuclear regulatory requirements (NRC) and industry standards for safety-critical systems
  • Develop prompt engineering strategies and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems for nuclear knowledge management
  • Implement robust testing, validation, and monitoring frameworks for AI models in high-stakes environments
  • Create and maintain documentation for AI models, algorithms, and deployment processes
  • Stay current with emerging AI technologies and evaluate their applicability to nuclear operations
  • Participate in cross-functional teams to integrate AI solutions with existing nuclear systems and workflows.
  • Experience in regulated industries (energy, nuclear, aerospace, or healthcare)
  • Knowledge of nuclear operations, safety protocols, or regulatory environment
  • Experience with RAG systems, vector databases, and semantic search technologies
  • Familiarity with AI governance, ethics, and responsible AI practices
  • Understanding of cybersecurity principles for AI systems
  • Experience with model fine-tuning, evaluation metrics, and performance optimization
  • Background in human-AI interaction and user-centered AI design
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, or related field (Master's preferred)
  • 3+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering with focus on generative AI technologies
  • Strong proficiency in Python and AI/ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain)
  • Experience with large language models (LLMs) and prompt engineering
  • Understanding of NLP, transformer architectures, and foundation models
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and MLOps practices
  • Ability to obtain and maintain security clearance for nuclear facility access
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills



What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

title: Especialista em novos negócios
description:
Tem vaga no A.C.Camargo!

Você já imaginou fazer parte de uma Instituição com mais de 72 anos de história, que impacta a sociedade todos os dias?

No A.C.Camargo Cancer Center, vamos além do tratamento do câncer. Unimos assistência, ensino e pesquisa para transformar vidas.

Nossa missão é não só cuidar dos pacientes, mas também gerar e compartilhar conhecimento, oferecendo um ambiente de crescimento e oportunidades igualitárias para nossos profissionais.

Contamos com um time de 5.000 pessoas que fazem daqui um dos “Lugares Mais Incríveis para Trabalhar”, segundo a FIA|Estadão.

Confira as especificações da vaga e envie seu currículo.

Junte-se a nós e faça parte dessa história de transformação.

Você será responsável por:

Identificar e desenvolver oportunidades comerciais com empresas externas, estabelecendo parcerias estratégicas que gerem novas receitas.

Realizar prospecção de novos clientes e parceiros, ampliando a base de negócios e explorando novas oportunidades de mercado.

Atuar em processos de negociação com instituições nacionais e internacionais, incluindo suporte à revisão de acordos legais (contratos de confidencialidade, distribuição e licenciamento).

Participar do planejamento estratégico para o desenvolvimento e lançamento de novos produtos e serviços.

Liderar a implementação de projetos voltados à detecção e acolhimento de potenciais casos oncológicos, garantindo a efetividade das ações.

Gerenciar o fluxo de receita interno, apoiando as áreas envolvidas em testes, parametrizações e processos de cobrança e pagamento.

Realizar análises de viabilidade econômica de oportunidades de negócio, utilizando ferramentas como planilhas de Excel e modelos financeiros.

Elaborar e acompanhar/analisar indicadores de desempenho relacionados à volumetria de pacientes encaminhados, receita, rentabilidade, share, faturamento e produtividade.

Apoiar a gestão de alianças estratégicas, assegurando uma transição eficiente entre as fases de negociação, formalização contratual e execução.

Fortalecer parcerias por meio de práticas eficazes de comunicação, resolução de conflitos e gestão de crises.

Desenvolver campanhas e iniciativas de educação corporativa sobre prevenção, diagnóstico precoce e adesão ao tratamento do câncer.

title: ASSISTENTE DE CUSTOMER SUCCESS
description:
Missão do cargo:

Atuar como ponto de apoio técnico durante o período de implantação, garantindo que clientes tenham suas dúvidas esclarecidas de forma ágil, clara e eficiente. O profissional será responsável por acompanhar demandas via chat e ticket, orientar usuários, organizar informações e contribuir para o andamento do projeto, sempre mantendo comunicação empática, precisa e alinhada às equipes envolvidas.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Atuar no Sucesso do Cliente e os interesses do negócio com a solução e serviços adquiridos, para entregar uma melhor experiência de uso em todas as etapas da jornada na TOTVS;
  • Atender dúvidas técnicas durante a implantação, principalmente via chat e ticket;
  • Acompanhar solicitações dos clientes;
  • Analisar situações, identificar causas e propor soluções alinhadas ao processo de implantação;
  • Encaminhar demandas para áreas internas quando necessário, garantindo comunicação clara e objetiva;
  • Orientar usuários sobre funcionalidades, processos e boas práticas do sistema;
  • Garantir fluidez e eficiência nos atendimentos.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Ensino médio completo. Desejável ensino superior cursando na área de Tecnologia, Recursos Humanos, Administração ou correlatas;
  • Conhecimento em Pacote Office e GSuite - nível básico
  • Desejável vivência na área de atendimento ao cliente através de chat, e-mails e/ou tickets.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de atendimento omnichannel (chat, ticket, telefone) como Zendesk, Movidesk ou similares será um diferencial.

title: Angular Front-End Developer
description:
Position : Angular Front-End Developer

Location : Brazil- Sao Paulo. (Hybrid)

• Angular – Expert – Mandatory

• Java – advanced– Mandatory

• UX/UI Designer – Intermediate – Optional

• Spring Boot – Advanced – Mandatory

We are seeking an Angular Front-End Developer with strong skills in building real-time, data-driven web applications. The ideal candidate is primarily a front-end specialist with Angular, but also brings hands-on experience as a Java developer for API/microservices.

Key Responsibilities:

· Design, develop, and maintain web applications using Angular (latest versions).

· Implement real-time data features using technologies such as ag-Grid or similar.

· Collaborate with backend teams and contribute to the development and integration of Java-based API/microservices.

· Ensure smooth communication between front-end and backend services (RESTful APIs, JSON, etc.).

· Optimize application performance for speed and scalability, especially in data-intensive scenarios.

· Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following best practices.

· Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to real-time data rendering and UI responsiveness.

· Stay up-to-date with the latest trends in front-end and backend development.

Must Have:

· Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).

· Solid experience in front-end development with Angular.

· Experience implementing real-time data features (e.g., ag-Grid).

· Hands-on experience as a Java developer, especially with microservices (Spring Boot or similar frameworks).

· Proficiency in TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.

· Experience integrating RESTful APIs and working with JSON data.

· Familiarity with responsive and adaptive design principles.

· Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git).

· Good communication skills in English (Minimum B2).

Desirable:

· Experience with state management libraries (e.g., NgRx, Akita).

· Familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).

· Experience with data visualization libraries (e.g., D3.js, Chart.js).

· Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodologies.

· Experience in financial services or other real-time, data-intensive industries.

· Interest or experience in UX design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Adobe XD).

· Good communication skills in Spanish.

Tarjetero de skills: Inglés B2+, Spring Boot o frameworks similares), TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5 y CSS3, RESTful APIs, JSON, Git

· Java – advanced– Mandatory

· UX/UI Designer – Intermediate – Optional

title: Lead WordPress Developer
description:
About Olly Olly

Olly Olly is a $25M ARR digital marketing company serving small businesses across the United States. We've built our reputation on transparency, results, and making sophisticated marketing accessible to business owners who need to focus on running their companies, not learning marketing complexities. As we scale our platform and demand generation efforts, we're looking for an exceptional WordPress developer who can lead our landing page creation and optimization function.


The Role

We're seeking a battle-tested WordPress Developer & Landing Page Team Lead who has personally managed the technical execution of high-stakes marketing campaigns with millions of dollars in ad spend. This isn't a role for someone who's built a few landing pages—we need someone who has been THE person responsible for ensuring every pixel fires correctly, every form submits properly, and every dollar of ad spend has a clear path to conversion tracking.


You'll lead a team of two WordPress developers, managing multiple concurrent projects while maintaining the exacting standards required when significant marketing budgets are on the line. You'll be the technical bridge between our marketing campaigns (primarily Meta, but across various channels) and our HubSpot CRM, ensuring flawless data flow and attribution tracking.


Core Responsibilities

Landing Page Development & Campaign Execution

  • Design, build, and deploy high-converting landing pages optimized for paid traffic from Meta, Google, and other advertising platforms
  • Own the complete technical implementation of marketing campaigns from concept through launch
  • Ensure pixel-perfect tracking setup across all campaigns, including Meta Pixel, Google Analytics, conversion tracking, and retargeting audiences
  • Implement and troubleshoot complex tracking scenarios including server-side tracking, UTM parameters, and multi-touch attribution
  • Optimize landing page performance for speed, mobile responsiveness, and conversion rates
  • Conduct A/B testing and implement rapid iterations based on campaign performance data


HubSpot Integration & Data Management

  • Build and maintain seamless integrations between landing pages and HubSpot CRM
  • Ensure accurate lead capture, form submissions, and data synchronization
  • Implement and validate proper lead source attribution and campaign tracking in HubSpot
  • Create custom workflows and automations to support campaign objectives
  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies and ensure marketing attribution accuracy


Technical Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and mentor a team of two WordPress developers
  • Manage workload distribution across multiple concurrent projects and campaigns
  • Establish and enforce development standards, quality assurance protocols, and best practices
  • Conduct code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback
  • Create project timelines and ensure on-time delivery of campaign assets
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex technical challenges


Quality Assurance & Risk Management

  • Implement rigorous QA processes, before any campaign launch.
  • Verify all tracking mechanisms are functioning correctly across devices and browsers
  • Maintain detailed documentation of tracking implementations and technical specifications
  • Proactively identify and resolve potential issues before they impact campaign performance
  • Ensure compliance with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) in all tracking implementations


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience
  • Direct experience managing technical execution of marketing campaigns with $1M+ in total ad spend
  • Must have been the PRIMARY person responsible for landing page build and campaign launch (not just a contributor on a larger team)
  • Portfolio demonstrating high-converting landing pages you've personally built and deployed


Technical Expertise

  • Proven experience implementing Git-based version control (GitLab, GitHub, or Bitbucket) and configuring Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for WordPress. Must be proficient in automating deployment across environments (Dev, Staging, Prod) and integrating unit and end-to-end tests into the workflow.
  • Expert-level WordPress development skills including ACF. Gutenberg, custom theme development, plugin customization, and advanced page builders (Elementor, Divi, or similar)
  • Deep understanding of Meta Business Suite, Meta Pixel implementation, and Conversions API
  • Proven experience with HubSpot CRM integration, forms, and tracking implementation
  • Strong command of HTML, CSS, JavaScript/jQuery, and PHP
  • Experience with VueJS is a plus
  • Experience with conversion tracking pixels across multiple platforms (Meta, Google, LinkedIn, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Google Tag Manager and server-side tracking implementations
  • Understanding of marketing analytics, attribution models, and conversion optimization principles


Management & Communication

  • Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring developers
  • Exceptional project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple high-priority projects
  • Clear communication style with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Comfortable with accountability when significant marketing budgets are at stake
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to marketing team members


Performance Standards

  • Meticulous attention to detail—one misconfigured pixel can cost thousands in wasted ad spend
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight campaign launch deadlines
  • Proactive problem-solver who anticipates issues before they become problems
  • Commitment to continuous learning as platforms and tracking methods evolve


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with marketing automation platforms beyond HubSpot (Marketo, Pardot, ActiveCampaign)
  • Familiarity with conversion rate optimization (CRO) methodologies and tools
  • Knowledge of SQL for custom reporting and data analysis
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms (VWO, Optimizely, Google Optimize)
  • Understanding of SEO best practices for landing pages
  • Certifications in Meta Blueprint, Google Analytics, or HubSpot
  • Experience in agency or fast-paced startup environments


What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days

  • Audit current landing page infrastructure and tracking implementations
  • Meet with marketing team to understand campaign objectives and conversion goals
  • Review existing team workflows and identify optimization opportunities
  • Successfully launch first campaign under your management with zero tracking issues

First 90 Days

  • Establish standardized QA protocols and documentation for all campaign launches
  • Implement improvements to team efficiency and project management processes
  • Build trust with marketing team through flawless technical execution
  • Identify and resolve any lingering tracking or integration issues

First Year

  • Lead team through successful execution of major product launch campaigns
  • Demonstrably improve landing page conversion rates through testing and optimization
  • Establish Olly Olly's landing page function as a competitive advantage
  • Develop your team members' skills and create succession planning


Why This Role Matters

When we invest in marketing campaigns, every dollar needs to count. You'll be the person ensuring that our tracking is accurate, our data is clean, and our ability to optimize is never compromised by technical issues. Your work directly impacts our ability to scale profitably and serve more small business owners.


Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary commensurate with experience, plus comprehensive benefits package. This is a full-time remote position, though you'll be working closely with team members across time zones.


Our Culture

We value directness, authenticity, and results over politics or polish. We're building something meaningful for small business owners who are often underserved by the marketing industry. We expect excellence but also recognize that real growth happens when people are supported, challenged, and given autonomy to do their best work.

title: Eletricista
description:
Eletricista

Resumo da função:

O eletricista será responsável por realizar instalações, manutenção preventiva e corretiva em sistemas elétricos, garantindo o funcionamento seguro e eficiente de equipamentos, máquinas e estruturas.


Salario: 2.619 +30% periculosidade

Responsabilidades:
  • Executar instalações elétricas em baixa e média tensão.
  • Realizar manutenção preventiva e corretiva em painéis, quadros de distribuição e circuitos elétricos.
  • Identificar e solucionar falhas elétricas.
  • Ler e interpretar diagramas, plantas e esquemas elétricos.
  • Seguir normas de segurança (NR-10, NR-35, entre outras).
  • Testar e inspecionar sistemas e componentes elétricos.
  • Documentar serviços realizados e reportar necessidades de reparo.
Requisitos:
  • Ensino médio completo; curso técnico em Elétrica é um diferencial.
  • Formação e certificação NR-10 (obrigatória) .
  • Experiência prévia na função.
  • Conhecimento em instalações industriais, prediais ou automação
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe e resolver problemas.
⭐ Diferenciais:
  • NR-35 (trabalho em altura), POP.
  • Experiência com comandos elétricos .
Condições de trabalho:
  • Regime: CLT
  • Jornada: horário comercial ou escala (definir).
  • Benefícios: vale-transporte, vale-refeição, vale alimentação, plano de saúde, Gympass

title: English Language Specialist
description:
iMerit seeks detail-oriented and analytically minded Multimodal GenAI Evaluation Analysts to perform highly nuanced evaluations of AI system outputs across different modalities: text, image, video, and multimodal interactions. Analysts will assess the accuracy, appropriateness, quality, clarity, and cultural alignment of model outputs against complex guidelines, ensuring that results align with project standards and real-world use cases. These evaluations will directly inform the development and fine-tuning of advanced large language models (LLMs), vision models (LVMs), and multimodal AI systems.


Role Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate outputs generated by LLMs across multiple modalities (text, image captions, video descriptions, and multimodal prompts).
  • Assess quality against project-specific criteria such as correctness, coherence, completeness, style, cultural appropriateness, and safety.
  • Identify subtle errors, hallucinations, or biases in AI responses.
  • Apply domain expertise and logical reasoning to resolve ambiguous or unclear outputs.
  • Provide detailed written feedback, tagging, and scoring of outputs to ensure consistency across the evaluation team.
  • Escalate unclear cases and contribute to refining evaluation guidelines.
  • Collaborate with Project Managers and Quality Leads to meet accuracy, reliability, and turnaround benchmarks.


Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong critical reading, observational, and evaluative skills across different modalities.
  • Ability to articulate nuanced judgments with precision and clarity.
  • Excellent English comprehension (CEFR B2 or above); additional languages a plus.
  • Familiarity with LLMs, generative AI, and multimodal systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to apply guidelines consistently.
  • Awareness of cultural and linguistic nuances, including potential bias and harm in AI outputs.
  • Comfort with evolving workflows, rapid feedback cycles, and complex quality frameworks.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
  • 1+ years of experience in data annotation, LLM evaluation, content moderation, or related AI/ML domains.
  • Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.
  • Strong understanding of language and multimodal communication (instruction following in image generation, fact-checking, narrative coherence in video, etc.).
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
  • Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Prior exposure to generative AI, prompt engineering, or LLM fine-tuning workflows is a plus.

While moderation of high-harm/high-risk material is not part of this role, candidates should be aware that occasional exposure to NSFW or otherwise sensitive content may occur due to imperfections in client-provided datasets. Applicants should indicate that they are comfortable working in environments where such incidental exposure is a possibility.


What We Offer:

  • Opportunities to shape the evaluation standards for next-generation multimodal AI systems.
  • Innovative and supportive global working environment.
  • Competitive compensation and flexible remote working arrangements.
  • Continuous learning and growth in applied AI evaluation.

Join iMerit to help shape the benchmarks and standards that ensure AI systems are accurate, safe, and culturally aware across text, vision, and multimodal applications. If rigorous analysis and innovation excite you, we encourage you to apply!

  • Escalate unclear cases and contribute to refining evaluation guidelines.
  • Collaborate with Project Managers and Quality Leads to meet accuracy, reliability, and turnaround benchmarks.


Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong critical reading, observational, and evaluative skills across different modalities.
  • Ability to articulate nuanced judgments with precision and clarity.
  • Excellent English comprehension (CEFR B2 or above); additional languages a plus.
  • Familiarity with LLMs, generative AI, and multimodal systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to apply guidelines consistently.
  • Awareness of cultural and linguistic nuances, including potential bias and harm in AI outputs.
  • Comfort with evolving workflows, rapid feedback cycles, and complex quality frameworks.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
  • 1+ years of experience in data annotation, LLM evaluation, content moderation, or related AI/ML domains.
  • Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.
  • Strong understanding of language and multimodal communication (instruction following in image generation, fact-checking, narrative coherence in video, etc.).
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
  • Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Prior exposure to generative AI, prompt engineering, or LLM fine-tuning workflows is a plus.

While moderation of high-harm/high-risk material is not part of this role, candidates should be aware that occasional exposure to NSFW or otherwise sensitive content may occur due to imperfections in client-provided datasets. Applicants should indicate that they are comfortable working in environments where such incidental exposure is a possibility.


What We Offer:

  • Opportunities to shape the evaluation standards for next-generation multimodal AI systems.
  • Innovative and supportive global working environment.
  • Competitive compensation and flexible remote working arrangements.
  • Continuous learning and growth in applied AI evaluation.

Join iMerit to help shape the benchmarks and standards that ensure AI systems are accurate, safe, and culturally aware across text, vision, and multimodal applications. If rigorous analysis and innovation excite you, we encourage you to apply!

title: Desenvolvedor Front-end (Pleno)
description:
Sobre a THREAD


A THREAD é uma consultoria de tecnologia e engenharia de software que cresce de forma consistente, impulsionada pela entrega contínua de valor e pela confiança de grandes marcas.


Somos especialistas em desenvolver sistemas sob medida, projetados para unir estratégia, dados e performance em cada solução.


Atuamos em parceria com empresas de diversos setores corporativos entregando produtos digitais, integrações e plataformas que conectam tecnologia à estratégia de negócio.


Descrição da vaga


Buscamos um Desenvolvedor Front-end Pleno para atuar 100% remoto na squad de sustentação e evolução de produtos digitais para um cliente do setor financeiro e automotivo.


Você fará parte de um time técnico, experiente e orientado a performance, garantindo estabilidade, correções estruturais e evoluções de front-end com qualidade THREAD.


Responsabilidades


  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir interfaces usando React com foco em performance e organização.
  • Estruturar e gerenciar estado global com Redux.
  • Criar componentes e estilos escaláveis com SASS.
  • Garantir qualidade de código, padrões e versionamento consistente.
  • Corrigir bugs, aprimorar telas existentes e implementar melhorias contínuas.
  • Colaborar com backend, UX e produto em demandas de sustentação e evolução.
  • Analisar e resolver problemas de impacto em produção com visão técnica e responsabilidade.


Requisitos Obrigatórios


  • 3+ anos de experiência com React
  • Experiência sólida com TypeScript
  • Domínio de Redux (ou Redux Toolkit)
  • SASS/SCSS avançado
  • Integração sólida com APIs REST
  • Git
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com legados modernos e organizar código existente
  • Boa leitura técnica e autonomia para resolver problemas sem depender de microgestão


Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)


  • Next.js
  • Testes (Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress)
  • Storybook
  • Conhecimento de design systems


Mindset esperado


  • Clareza e objetividade na comunicação
  • Comprometimento absoluto com as entregas de backlog
  • Responsabilidade real em cumprir o combinado na planning
  • Organização e disciplina para manter previsibilidade
  • Autonomia para resolver problemas sem depender de microgestão
  • Capacidade de leitura de contexto e diagnóstico rápido
  • Postura colaborativa, madura e orientada a impacto
  • Foco em simplicidade, qualidade e execução consistente


O que oferecemos


  • Atuação 100% remota
  • Projetos de grande impacto no setor financeiro e automotivo
  • Time técnico sênior e de alta performance
  • Cultura de execução com foco em qualidade e clareza
  • Contratação PJ
  • Horário de trabalho: das 8h às 17h (horário comercial fixo)

title: Vendas internas
description:
Se Você é um vendedor nato, sangue no olho, com sede por vender e quer ter um crescimento rápido de carreira nessa área, essa vaga é para você!


Resumo: O Vendedor Interno, ou Inside Sales, opera diretamente de um escritório ou de casa. Este profissional utiliza ferramentas digitais como e-mail, WhatsApp, telefone e videoconferências para prospectar, negociar e fechar vendas, sem a necessidade de deslocamentos externos. A posição exige um alto nível de conhecimento técnico sobre os produtos, excelente capacidade de comunicação e uma forte habilidade em vendas e persuasão.

Tipo de Operação: venda de infoprodutos


Principais Atividades e Responsabilidades:

  • Prospecção ativa de novos clientes por meio de chamadas telefônicas, e-mails e reuniões por videoconferência.
  • Realização de apresentações detalhadas sobre os produtos e serviços para os clientes.
  • Envio e negociação de propostas comerciais, seguindo o acompanhamento até o fechamento da venda.
  • Gerenciamento de relações com clientes através do CRM, mantendo um histórico detalhado de interações, necessidades e transações.
  • Resolução de dúvidas e fornecimento de informações adicionais aos clientes como parte do suporte pós-venda.
  • Organização e priorização diária das atividades de vendas para garantir o cumprimento de metas e prazos.


O que Buscamos: Pré-requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas internas ou televendas.
  • Profundo conhecimento dos produtos ou serviços oferecidos pela empresa.
  • Habilidade de comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Proficiência em ferramentas de CRM e plataformas de comunicação digital.
  • Capacidade de realizar múltiplas tarefas, organizar e priorizar de forma eficaz.


Habilidades:

  • Capacidade de compreender e atender às necessidades dos clientes, construindo relacionamentos de longo prazo.
  • Paciência e habilidade para gerenciar o ciclo de vendas completo, do primeiro contato ao fechamento e follow-up.
  • Empatia para se conectar com clientes e entender suas demandas específicas.
  • Agilidade e precisão no atendimento, proporcionando respostas rápidas e soluções adequadas.


Desejável:

  • Formação em Marketing, Administração, Vendas ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência anterior em ambientes de vendas B2B / B2C.

Remuneração e Benefícios:

  • Salário base competitivo com comissão sobre as vendas..
  • Acesso a treinamentos e desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Modelo de trabalho: Remoto


Adicionais:

  • Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento dentro da empresa.
  • Cultura empresarial de suporte e inovação.
  • Acesso a tecnologias de ponta para desempenho das funções.

Se Você é um vendedor nato, sangue no olho, com sede por vender e quer ter um crescimento rápido de carreira nessa área, essa vaga é para você!


Resumo: O Vendedor Interno, ou Inside Sales, opera diretamente de um escritório ou de casa. Este profissional utiliza ferramentas digitais como e-mail, WhatsApp, telefone e videoconferências para prospectar, negociar e fechar vendas, sem a necessidade de deslocamentos externos. A posição exige um alto nível de conhecimento técnico sobre os produtos, excelente capacidade de comunicação e uma forte habilidade em vendas e persuasão.

Tipo de Operação: venda de infoprodutos


Principais Atividades e Responsabilidades:

  • Prospecção ativa de novos clientes por meio de chamadas telefônicas, e-mails e reuniões por videoconferência.
  • Realização de apresentações detalhadas sobre os produtos e serviços para os clientes.
  • Envio e negociação de propostas comerciais, seguindo o acompanhamento até o fechamento da venda.
  • Gerenciamento de relações com clientes através do CRM, mantendo um histórico detalhado de interações, necessidades e transações.
  • Resolução de dúvidas e fornecimento de informações adicionais aos clientes como parte do suporte pós-venda.
  • Organização e priorização diária das atividades de vendas para garantir o cumprimento de metas e prazos.


O que Buscamos: Pré-requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas internas ou televendas.
  • Profundo conhecimento dos produtos ou serviços oferecidos pela empresa.
  • Habilidade de comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Proficiência em ferramentas de CRM e plataformas de comunicação digital.
  • Capacidade de realizar múltiplas tarefas, organizar e priorizar de forma eficaz.


Habilidades:

  • Capacidade de compreender e atender às necessidades dos clientes, construindo relacionamentos de longo prazo.
  • Paciência e habilidade para gerenciar o ciclo de vendas completo, do primeiro contato ao fechamento e follow-up.
  • Empatia para se conectar com clientes e entender suas demandas específicas.
  • Agilidade e precisão no atendimento, proporcionando respostas rápidas e soluções adequadas.


Desejável:

  • Formação em Marketing, Administração, Vendas ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência anterior em ambientes de vendas B2B / B2C.

Remuneração e Benefícios:

  • Salário base competitivo com comissão sobre as vendas..
  • Acesso a treinamentos e desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Modelo de trabalho: Remoto


Adicionais:

  • Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento dentro da empresa.
  • Cultura empresarial de suporte e inovação.
  • Acesso a tecnologias de ponta para desempenho das funções.

title: ServiceNow Developer with Now Assist/AI
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are seeking an experienced "ServiceNow Developer" to design, implement, and maintain comprehensive ServiceNow solutions across multiple modules and business processes.


Responsibility :


  • Platform Development & Configuration:
  • Develop and maintain ServiceNow applications using JavaScript, HTML, and platform best practices
  • Configure Business Rules, UI Policies, Client Scripts, and Data Policies to enforce business logic and enhance user experience
  • Build custom workflows using Workflow Editor and Flow Designer for complex automation scenarios
  • Create and optimize Service Catalog items, record producers, and order guides with advanced variable logic
  • Proficiency in JavaScript, HTML, and ServiceNow platform architecture
  • Experience with ITSM, HRSD, ITOM, Discovery, Service Mapping and Now Assist
  • Strong understanding of ServiceNow administration and configuration management
  • Ability to translate complex business requirements into technical solutions
  • Experience with integration technologies and API development
  • Configure Incident Management processes including categorization, SLAs, auto-assignment rules, and escalation procedures
  • Implement Major Incident Management workflows with communication templates and war room functionality
  • Design Request Management workflows with approval chains and fulfillment automation
  • Certified System Administrator (CSA)
  • Certified Application Developer (CAD)
  • Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) – ITSM, HRSD, or CSM
  • Now Assist Certification
  • Certified Technical Architect (CTA) – for senior-level candidates
  • Micro-Certifications – such as Flow Designer, Virtual Agent, or Performance Analytics


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?

Health insurance

title: Local Operations & Project Manager (Brazil)
description:
About TopDoer

TopDoer is a Workforce Management (WFM) platform helping companies instantly meet their workforce needs by connecting them with reliable freelancers and blue-collar workers on demand . We support businesses in scaling operations fast, efficiently, and with full flexibility.


Role Description

We are looking for an experienced Operations & Project Manager to lead our local activities in Brazil. This role is ideal for someone with strong leadership skills, excellent communication abilities, and a hands-on approach to operational management.


Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate and support the performance of the local operational team .
  • Manage and oversee daily work of local service providers (ISPs) .
  • Communicate with clients: resolve incidents, clarify needs, collect feedback to improve processes and product quality.
  • Contribute to planning and monitor achievement of financial KPIs .


Requirements

  • Legal residence in Brazil (Brazilian passport or valid residence permit ).
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English or Russian (mandatory)
  • Proven experience in project management and team leadership .


Schedule

Full-time — flexibility required (24/7 operations environment

title: SEM Manager
description:
Descrição da Vaga – SEM Manager

Na Texonica Innovations , acreditamos na importância da estratégia, experimentação e otimização contínua. Cada projeto é uma oportunidade de trabalhar com criatividade, precisão e curiosidade, gerando resultados reais.

Nosso time é composto por profissionais experientes, que compartilham conhecimento e oferecem um ambiente para você crescer e entregar o seu melhor trabalho. Fornecemos recursos para seu desenvolvimento profissional — cursos, mentorias e oportunidades reais de evolução. Valorizamos pessoas com sede de aprendizado e vontade de se desenvolver continuamente.

Responsabilidades

Planejar, executar e otimizar campanhas de Search Engine Marketing (Google Ads, Bing e outros).

Realizar pesquisa de palavras-chave, análise de público e de concorrentes para identificar oportunidades de crescimento.

Criar textos publicitários atraentes e testar variações para maximizar CTR e conversões.

Monitorar métricas de desempenho, interpretar dados e aplicar otimizações baseadas em insights.

Colaborar com equipes de criação, análise e estratégia para alinhar as iniciativas de SEM com os objetivos gerais de marketing.

Responder rapidamente a feedbacks e ajustar campanhas para garantir performance e eficiência.

Requisitos

Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência prática em SEM.

Domínio do Google Ads, ferramentas de pesquisa de palavras-chave e rastreamento de conversões.

Perfil analítico, proativo e atento aos detalhes.

Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas campanhas simultaneamente.

Boa comunicação e habilidade para trabalhar de forma eficaz em ambiente remoto.

Diferenciais

Certificação em Google Ads.

Experiência com CRO, retargeting ou testes de landing pages.

Conhecimento de outras ferramentas ou plataformas de marketing de performance.

Sobre a Posição

Regime: Full-time ou Part-time

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto

Remuneração: A combinar

title: Engenheiro de dados pleno
description:
Modelo de contrato: PJ.

Ter disponibilidade para visitar a empresa em Osório – RS, 1x ao mês, é um grande diferencial para a contratação.


A ConCrédito é especialista em antecipação do saque FGTS, crédito do trabalhador, INSS, entre outras linhas de crédito, com mais de 300 mil clientes ativos e operações em forte crescimento. Estamos em busca de um Analista de Dados Pleno para fortalecer nosso time de Data & Growth, ajudando a transformar grandes volumes de dados em insights estratégicos que impulsionem aquisição, retenção e crescimento de receita da empresa.


Sua missão


Construir análises e dashboards que permitam monitorar o funil de vendas e a performance dos canais digitais e de growth , suportando decisões estratégicas e garantindo que a ConCrédito aproveite ao máximo sua base de clientes.

Você será a referência em dados para o time, garantindo qualidade, organização e clareza nas informações utilizadas por Comercial, Marketing e IA .


Como será o seu dia a dia


  • Estruturar e manter dashboards estratégicos e operacionais em Power BI e Metabase.
  • Integrar novas fontes de dados ao data warehouse e às ferramentas de analytics quando necessário.
  • Garantir o bom uso de ferramentas como Google Analytics.
  • Escrever queries em SQL para explorar dados no Snowflake.
  • Garantir qualidade, consistência e integridade das bases de dados.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com BI, Growth, IA e Comercial, traduzindo dados em insights práticos.
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento de modelos de segmentação de clientes (cohort e scoring) para orientar estratégias de campanhas comerciais.
  • Implementar ou propor soluções criativas com uso de Inteligência Artificial.


O que buscamos


  • Experiência sólida com SQL (avançado).
  • Experiência com DBT.
  • Vivência com Snowflake.

title: Engenheiro de obras
description:
Venha fazer parte da Masterboi!

Somos da Masterboi, uma empresa genuinamente Pernambucana dedicada a alimentar vidas, com matriz em Recife – PE, há mais de 24 anos construindo história no mercado nacional e internacional de processamento e distribuição de alimentos, tornando-se referência no segmento.

Estamos buscando um talento para a posição de:


Engenheiro de Obras (CLT / Presencial)

  • Elaborar, analisar e acompanhar cronogramas físico-financeiros da obra.
  • Planejar recursos (mão de obra, materiais, equipamentos e serviços) para garantir o andamento dentro do prazo e orçamento.
  • Identificar riscos e propor ações corretivas ou preventivas.
  • Interpretar projetos arquitetônicos, estruturais, elétricos, hidráulicos e complementares.
  • Garantir a conformidade técnica das atividades, conforme normas técnicas (ABNT), legislação e boas práticas de engenharia.
  • Elaborar e revisar memoriais descritivos, especificações técnicas e procedimentos executivo.
  • Supervisionar equipes próprias e de empreiteiras, garantindo execução de acordo com os projetos.
  • Controlar a qualidade dos serviços executados, realizando inspeções e ensaios, quando necessário.
  • Monitorar diariamente o progresso da obra e registrar ocorrências relevantes.
  • Solicitar, controlar e aprovar materiais, comparando especificações com o projeto.
  • Analisar medições e notas fiscais de fornecedores e empreiteiras.
  • Participar na negociação e contratação de serviços terceirizados.
  • Acompanhar custos, evitando desvios orçamentários.
  • Garantir o cumprimento das normas de segurança (NRs).
  • Realizar reuniões periódicas com a equipe de obra, fornecedores e clientes.
  • Preparar relatórios técnicos e gerenciais sobre o andamento da obra.
  • Atuar como ponto focal entre o canteiro e a diretoria/gerência de engenharia.


Requisitos:

  • Formação em Engenharia Civil/ Mecânica ou Elétrica com CREA ativo
  • Conhecimento em gestão de obras, planejamento e execução.
  • Domínio de cronogramas (MS Project ou similares).
  • Leitura e interpretação de projetos estruturais, arquitetônicos e complementares.


Informações adicionais:

  • Compras facilitadas nas lojas Masterboi;
  • Refeitório da empresa;
  • Seguro de vida e bem-estar;
  • Parcerias educacionais: Descontos em cursos técnicos e de nível superior.
  • Plano de Saúde por adesão.
  • Wellhub- Gympass
