title: Profissional Desenvolvedor .NET Pleno/Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 51671


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?


- Mais de 4 anos de experiência em .NET nas versões atuais;

- Experiência em AWS ( Ec2, S3, SNS, SQS, Lambdas);

- Experiência com microsserviços, padrões de projetos modernos, boas práticas de arquitetura dominando conceitos;

- Experiência com Programação orientada a objetos (POO);

- Atuar profissionalmente com filas de mensageria;

- Familiaridade com sistemas com muitas requisições e alta escalabilidade.


O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


As oportunidades são CLT com muitos benefícios, olha só:


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Engenheiro(a) de Planejamento Agrícola Sênior
description:
Que desafio temos para você?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) SR para atuar no time de Planejamento Agrícola.


Quais as responsabilidades?

  • Responsável pelo planejamento operacional das atividades de colheita, preparo e plantio;
  • Liderar os ritos semanais e mensais de planejamento dentro da unidade;
  • Elaborar apresentações gerenciais com indicadores e planos;
  • Acompanhar o volume de cana da unidade;
  • Construir e apresentar cenários relacionados ao planejamento agrícola.


Quais os requisitos?

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia Agronômica ou Agrícola;
  • Necessário conhecimento em operação de tratos culturais, colheita e plantio mecanizado;
  • Desejável experiência em planejamento agrícola;
  • Domínio do pacote Office, em especial Excel;
  • Disponibilidade para residir em Olímpia, São José do Rio Preto ou Guapiaçu.


Qual localidade?

Olímpia - SP | Unidade Cruz Alta


O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.


Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.


Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

Se você gosta de desafios, quer trabalhar perto da liderança e crescer dentro de uma empresa que está expandindo rápido, essa vaga é para você.

A HarmonizaPRO é uma aceleradora comercial especializada em clínicas de harmonização facial.

  • Treinamento comercial
  • Gestão interna
  • Aumento de ticket médio
  • Estrutura de vendas completa

Estamos localizados em Balneário Camboriú e somos uma empresa em forte expansão.

Instagram: @pietro.boscardin | @harmoniza.pro

  • Gerenciar e nutrir sua carteira de leads com follow-ups consistentes
  • Reativar leads antigos e transformá-los em novas oportunidades

title: Performance Tracking & Tag Management Specialist (LATAM) — Remote
description:
Join GrowthAssistant as a Performance Tracking & Tag Management Specialist!

Open to candidates from LATAM countries only (e.g., Mexico, Brazil, Colombia)


About the Role

We’re looking for a detail-oriented Performance Tracking & Tag Management Specialist to support our client’s Paid Media team. You’ll ensure every digital advertising campaign is tracked accurately and consistently, building and maintaining the infrastructure behind performance measurement. This includes configuring, QA’ing, and troubleshooting tracking systems—mainly via Google Tag Manager (GTM)—to ensure data integrity and accurate attribution.


By partnering closely with Paid Search Specialists and Account Strategists, you’ll help eliminate inaccurate conversion data, improve ROI reporting, and enable smarter optimization decisions across 60+ client accounts.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Implement, QA, and maintain tags, triggers, and pixels in Google Tag Manager (GTM) across client websites.
  • Audit and troubleshoot conversion tracking configurations across platforms (Google Ads, Meta Ads, Bing Ads).
  • Validate conversion actions to ensure form fills, purchases, or other lead events are correctly recorded, avoiding inflated reporting.
  • Standardize and document tagging schemas for all client accounts in Salesforce, ensuring consistent fields (budget, KPIs, goals, tracking status).
  • Partner with Paid Search Specialists to align conversion actions and budgets with each client’s true business objectives.
  • Create and maintain a tracking QA checklist and intake form to guide new account setups and audits.
  • Perform ongoing health checks of all tracking infrastructure to proactively identify broken tags or discrepancies.
  • Collaborate with the client’s marketing team to recommend scalable intake and QA processes (e.g., onboarding forms, Salesforce automation).
  • Produce clear documentation for all tagging and data validation processes to ensure team-wide continuity.


What We’re Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience managing Google Tag Manager (tag creation, testing, triggers, version control).
  • Solid understanding of conversion tracking across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and other paid media platforms.
  • Hands-on experience validating data layers, debugging tags, and testing event triggers in browser consoles.
  • Strong ability to QA campaign tracking and identify discrepancies between actual and reported performance data.
  • Demonstrated experience creating or maintaining documentation (SOPs, QA templates, checklists).
  • Excellent communication skills to partner with account managers, strategists, and technical teams.


Nice-to-Have:

  • Familiarity with Salesforce or other CRM systems for marketing data management.
  • Understanding of enhanced conversions, consent mode, and privacy-related tagging.
  • Exposure to GA4 or other analytics platforms for event-based measurement.
  • Experience supporting agencies managing high-volume client portfolios.
  • Prior experience collaborating with web developers or marketing analysts on data validation and tag troubleshooting.


Durable Skills

  • Highly detail-oriented, precise, and methodical in QA and documentation.
  • Process-driven mindset—capable of building repeatable tagging and validation frameworks.
  • Problem-solving mentality with a focus on scalable solutions.
  • Strong collaboration and communication across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ownership mentality with a focus on accuracy, quality, and reliability.


Why You’ll Love Working Here

At GrowthAssistant, you’ll collaborate with a diverse, talented team, sharpen your skills with global clients, and make an impact in your career. We value your growth and recognize your contributions every step of the way.


Apply today and take the next step in your career with GrowthAssistant!

  • Vendas e Satisfação do Cliente: Conhecimento em técnicas de vendas e foco em estratégias para alcançar e superar metas, mantendo altos níveis de satisfação do cliente.

title: Marketing Automation & Integration Engineer
description:
We are seeking a highly motivated Marketing Automation & Integration Engineer to join our team.


Our Client is one of the United States’ largest insurers, providing a wide range of insurance and financial services products with gross written premiums well over US$25 Billion (P&C). They proudly serve more than 10 million U.S. households with more than 19 million individual policies across all 50 states through the efforts of over 48,000 exclusive and independent agents and nearly 18,500 employees. Finally, our Client is part of one the largest Insurance Groups in the world.


What to expect on your journey with us:

  • A solid and innovative company with a strong market presence
  • A dynamic, diverse, and multicultural work environment
  • Leaders with deep market knowledge and strategic vision
  • Continuous learning and development


Team Function:

The team is responsible for architecting and maintaining scalable MarTech solutions, with a focus on:

- Data integration

- Customer journey orchestration

- Marketing automation

This team operates within the Data, Tech, and Operations tower of the Direct BU.


Role Description:

This role centers on the implementation and optimization of a MarTech data flow pattern involving Snowflake, Segment, Braze, and other SaaS platforms.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Design and maintain data pipelines between Snowflake, Segment CDP, Braze, and additional platforms
  • Implement real-time and batch data ingestion strategies
  • Manage customer event tracking and identity resolution within Segment
  • Orchestrate personalized marketing campaigns in Braze using dynamic segmentation and behavioral triggers
  • Ensure data integrity and feedback loops from Braze back into Snowflake via Segment
  • Automate data transformations and enrichment using scripting languages
  • Monitor system performance and troubleshoot integration issues across platforms


Requirements


  • 4 to 6 years of experience in IT environments with a strong focus on MarTech architecture.
  • Familiarity with insurance industry data and customer lifecycle models is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/IT, Data Science, Software Engineering.
  • Fluency in English


Software / Tools

  • Segment CDP
  • Braze
  • Snowflake
  • Scripting Languages (Python / JS)


Other Critical Skills

  • Reverse ETL
  • Data Orchestration Platforms
  • Customer Data Schema Design
  • Consent & Preference Management
  • Data modeling and ETL/ELT Pipeline
  • API Integrations / Webhooks
  • Customer journey mapping and automation logic


Benefits


This position comes with competitive compensation and benefits package:

  • Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • Career development and training opportunities
  • Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office-based)
  • Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally reknowned group
  • Private Health Insurance
  • Pension Plan
  • Paid Time Off
  • Training & Development

title: Marketing Automation & Integration Engineer
description:
We are seeking a highly motivated Marketing Automation & Integration Engineer to join our team.


Our Client is one of the United States’ largest insurers, providing a wide range of insurance and financial services products with gross written premiums well over US$25 Billion (P&C). They proudly serve more than 10 million U.S. households with more than 19 million individual policies across all 50 states through the efforts of over 48,000 exclusive and independent agents and nearly 18,500 employees. Finally, our Client is part of one the largest Insurance Groups in the world.


What to expect on your journey with us:

  • A solid and innovative company with a strong market presence
  • A dynamic, diverse, and multicultural work environment
  • Leaders with deep market knowledge and strategic vision
  • Continuous learning and development


Team Function:

The team is responsible for architecting and maintaining scalable MarTech solutions, with a focus on:

- Data integration

- Customer journey orchestration

- Marketing automation

This team operates within the Data, Tech, and Operations tower of the Direct BU.


Role Description:

This role centers on the implementation and optimization of a MarTech data flow pattern involving Snowflake, Segment, Braze, and other SaaS platforms.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Design and maintain data pipelines between Snowflake, Segment CDP, Braze, and additional platforms
  • Implement real-time and batch data ingestion strategies
  • Manage customer event tracking and identity resolution within Segment
  • Orchestrate personalized marketing campaigns in Braze using dynamic segmentation and behavioral triggers
  • Ensure data integrity and feedback loops from Braze back into Snowflake via Segment
  • Automate data transformations and enrichment using scripting languages
  • Monitor system performance and troubleshoot integration issues across platforms


Requirements


  • 4 to 6 years of experience in IT environments with a strong focus on MarTech architecture.
  • Familiarity with insurance industry data and customer lifecycle models is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/IT, Data Science, Software Engineering.
  • Fluency in English


Software / Tools

  • Segment CDP
  • Braze
  • Snowflake
  • Scripting Languages (Python / JS)


Other Critical Skills

  • Reverse ETL
  • Data Orchestration Platforms
  • Customer Data Schema Design
  • Consent & Preference Management
  • Data modeling and ETL/ELT Pipeline
  • API Integrations / Webhooks
  • Customer journey mapping and automation logic


Benefits


This position comes with competitive compensation and benefits package:

  • Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • Career development and training opportunities
  • Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office-based)
  • Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally reknowned group
  • Private Health Insurance
  • Pension Plan
  • Paid Time Off
  • Training & Development

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de sistemas
description:
Somos o grupo educacional mais diversificado do país. Todos os dias, criamos futuros incríveis através da inovação. Colocamos a mão na massa para tirar as ideias do papel e colocá-las em prática. Enfrentamos desafios com resiliência e nos adaptamos às mudanças constantes.


Por aqui, somos um time e não heróis, guiados pela vontade de fazer a diferença e conectados de um só jeito, o #JeitoCogna. Nossa relação é direta e respeitosa, e o sucesso dos nossos alunos e clientes é o nosso sucesso.


Além disso, valorizamos a diversidade, porque sabemos que quanto mais diverso é o nosso repertório, mais abrangente e inclusivo seremos. Juntos impulsionamos as pessoas a construírem uma melhor versão de si! E aí, bora fazer parte da empresa líder absoluta do segmento educacional? Vem pra Cogna.



Responsabilidades e atribuições:

- Liderar tecnicamente equipes de desenvolvimento ágil, garantindo a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade, escaláveis e alinhadas às metas de negócio.

- Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de sistemas, promovendo boas práticas de engenharia de software, segurança da informação, automação e observabilidade.

- Atuar como facilitador entre áreas técnicas e de negócio, traduzindo necessidades estratégicas em soluções tecnológicas eficientes.

- Conduzir o planejamento e acompanhamento de projetos, assegurando prazos, custos, indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e qualidade das entregas.

- Implementar padrões de governança técnica, versionamento, testes automatizados, CI/CD e monitoramento contínuo de performance.

- Apoiar o crescimento técnico do time por meio de mentorias, feedbacks estruturados e planos de desenvolvimento individual.

- Fomentar uma cultura de colaboração, aprendizado contínuo, inovação e melhoria constante nos processos de desenvolvimento.

- Participar ativamente de decisões estratégicas sobre tecnologias, ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento que impactem a arquitetura corporativa.

- Promover o uso racional de recursos em nuvem, garantindo eficiência operacional, segurança e sustentabilidade financeira.

- Atuar na mitigação de riscos técnicos e na resolução de incidentes críticos, com foco em análise de causa raiz e prevenção.


Requisitos e qualificações:

- Experiência comprovada em Engenharia de Software, Arquitetura de Sistemas e Liderança Técnica de equipes ágeis de alta performance.

- Domínio técnico em:

- Arquitetura de microserviços e integração de sistemas distribuídos

- Cloud Computing (preferencialmente AWS, Azure ou GCP)

- Banco de dados relacionais e não relacionais

- Mensageria e streaming de dados (ex: Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ)

- APIs RESTful, GraphQL e boas práticas de versionamento

- Ferramentas de CI/CD, containers (Docker, Kubernetes) e observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK)

- Forte conhecimento em metodologias Agile/Scrum/Kanban, gestão de backlog e métricas de produtividade técnica (lead time, throughput, qualidade de código).

- Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

- Certificações desejáveis: Scrum Master, AWS Solutions Architect, DevOps, Cloud Practitioner ou similares.

- Excelentes habilidades de liderança, comunicação assertiva, gestão de conflitos, visão sistêmica e tomada de decisão baseada em dados.

- Perfil hands-on, com capacidade de atuar estrategicamente e operacionalmente quando necessário.

- Proatividade, curiosidade tecnológica e capacidade de inspirar e engajar pessoas em torno de objetivos comuns.

title: JD Edwards Consultant with CNC Activities
description:
This a Full Time remote position working in Brazil with US clients.


We offer:

  • $5,000 BRL to $11,200 per month depending on experience
  • Vale Refeição / Alimentação R$ 992,00
  • Plano de Saúde Bradesco ( Descontos Sujeito a Alteração)
  • Plano Odontológico Bradesco
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Auxílio Creche


Title: JD Edwards Consultant

• Candidate should have done with at least 4 full cycle JDE project implementation / Migration / Upgrade with at least years of industry experience of which minimum 8-10 years of experience in JD Edwards CNC OneWorld/One World Xe/Enterprise One,

• Good knowledge in the Installation, Configuration, Upgrade of the Enterprise One

• Should be able to propose CNC solutions based on the client requirements.

• Design the Architecture of the Enterprise One

• Experience in Hardware Sizing, System Administration, Architecting the Enterprise One Server solutions.

• Candidate should have experience in CNC Activities like Security, Package build Deployment, Object Migration workbench and Performance Tuning

• Candidate should have experience in Installation / upgrade experience in latest version of JDE. Experience in installing Service packs, ASU/ESUs

• Candidate should have good experience in Installation of Deployment Server, Enterprise Server, Citrix Servers, JAS servers

• Candidate should have an experience as administrator in Operating Systems (Unix / Windows / OS400) and Databases (Oracle / SQL / DB2)

• Working experience of Global Delivery Model (Onsite/Offshore Model) is an added advantage

• Candidate should possess excellent analytical and problem solving skills

• Candidate must be an excellent team player

• Candidate should possess excellent customer interaction skills on technology or business issues

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (Python, React)
description:
Senior Fullstack Engineer (Python, React)


MetaCTO – AI Developer – Remote

MetaCTO helps companies design, build, and scale high-impact software using modern engineering practices and AI-assisted development workflows. We’re hiring a Senior Fullstack Engineer (Python, React) to build client-facing applications, internal platforms, and AI-enabled automation features across our product portfolio. You’ll work on backend services, frontend experiences, system integrations, and intelligent workflows that support MetaCTO’s delivery teams and customers.


What You’ll Do

Backend (Python)

• Build backend services, APIs, and automation workflows in Python

• Integrate applications with external systems, developer platforms, and CI/CD pipelines

• Implement AI-assisted features using LLMs and model-serving APIs

• Work with automation and orchestration frameworks to streamline internal processes

• Implement structured logging, observability, and diagnostics

• Contribute to architecture design and scalability decisions

Frontend (React)

• Build responsive, high-quality UIs in React and TypeScript

• Create intuitive UX for data-rich features, dashboards, and internal tools

• Build interfaces for automation controls, AI-driven outputs, and system insights

• Collaborate with design to simplify complex technical workflows

• Integrate frontend components with backend APIs and real-time services


What We’re Looking For

• 5+ years of engineering experience across backend and frontend

• Strong Python expertise with FastAPI, Flask, async programming, and API design

• Strong React and TypeScript experience with modern component patterns

• Experience integrating with GitHub, GitLab, CI/CD pipelines, or other dev platforms

• Familiarity with automation workflows, orchestration tools, or agent frameworks

• Hands-on experience with AI models, LLM APIs, or prompt-based systems

• Strong understanding of automated testing, code quality, and observability

• Comfortable in a fast-paced, high-autonomy environment

• Clear written communication skills


Bonus Points

• Experience with microservices, serverless workflows, or complex API ecosystems

• AWS experience or certifications such as Solutions Architect or DevOps Engineer

• Background in cloud architecture or technical leadership

• Fluent English


Why Join Us

• Remote-first culture with a focus on autonomy and deep technical work

• High-ownership role with direct impact on architecture and product direction

• Opportunity to build real AI-enabled features used across client projects

• Work with modern frameworks, LLMs, and emerging AI automation tools

• Competitive compensation


How to Apply

Send your resume or LinkedIn profile along with a short note on why this role aligns with your experience and interests. MetaCTO provides AI-enabled app design, strategy, and development from concept to launch and beyond, partnering with startups and scaling teams to build high-impact software products.

  • Elasticsearch

Estamos com uma oportunidade em aberto para Analista de Planejamento Tributário Sênior , para atuar em nosso escritório localizado em São Paulo/SP , na região da Vila Olímpia, em modelo presencial, com um dia de home office na semana.


Objetivo do cargo: atuar de forma estratégica no planejamento e gestão tributária da companhia, assegurando conformidade fiscal, eficiência operacional e identificação de oportunidades de otimização tributária. Responsável por análises técnicas, modelagens e estudos de impacto da reforma tributária, contribuindo para a tomada de decisão e fortalecimento da governança fiscal do grupo.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento e execução das estratégias de planejamento tributário (tributos diretos e indiretos);
  • Realizar estudos e simulações sobre impactos da reforma tributária, propondo ajustes e soluções;
  • Elaborar e manter modelos analíticos e relatórios de performance tributária (KPIs);
  • Apoiar a avaliação de riscos e oportunidades fiscais, integrando-se às áreas Contábil, Fiscal, Jurídica e Financeira;
  • Acompanhar auditorias e fiscalizações, fornecendo suporte técnico e mitigando riscos;
  • Propor melhorias em processos e controles tributários, assegurando compliance e eficiência;
  • Apoiar o mapeamento e revisão de regimes fiscais e elaborar apresentações executivas à diretoria.


Buscamos profissional que tenha:

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Economia ou Ciências Contábeis;
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas correlatas;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Experiência consolidada em planejamento e gestão tributária;
  • Excel avançado e domínio do Pacote Office;
  • Conhecimento em SAP (módulo fiscal) e ferramentas de modelagem de cenários;
  • Sólido domínio técnico em IRPJ, CSLL, PIS, COFINS, ICMS, ISS e compliance tributário;
  • Perfil analítico, detalhista, com visão estratégica e habilidade de comunicação com áreas de negócio.


Benefícios que geram energia:

  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica.
  • Remuneração Variável Anual (PPR).
  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação.
  • Auxílio Transporte, Fretado ou Estacionamento (a depender da localidade).
  • Seguro de Vida.
  • Previdência Privada.
  • TotalPass (Auxílio Academia e Bem-estar).
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade estendida.
  • Gift Card no mês do seu aniversário.
  • Gift Card de Natal.

title: Escalation Manager
description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
Who We Are
This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.
Job Description
Your Career
The Escalation Manager position is a strategic, high-visibility role that provides the highest level of escalation for customer issues that are jeopardizing the Palo Alto Networks business relationship and/or sales opportunities with key customers.
The Escalation Manager will lead and manage the resolution of customers' critical issues by forming and leading an interdepartmental, cross-functional, and geographically dispersed Palo Alto Networks virtual team which are formed based on the customer and escalation needs.
In leading the virtual team, the escalations Manager will liaise with and work across various Palo Alto Networks functional organizations and business units, and with all levels of the company; from Support, Sales, Product management, and development engineers to management and corporate executives.
Your Impact
  • Escalation Leadership
    • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
    • Drive clear intake, scope, priority, exit criteria and end to end process to achieve streamlined escalation resolution
    • Drive global consistency across portfolio and customers
    • Maintain and improve procedures for customer and field personnel for escalation handling
    • Handle direct customer leadership and technical audiences as appropriate
  • Expedite Resolution
    • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
    • Strong ability to influence and be effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account and issues
    • Clear accountability on relevant owners on driving to target service-level Objectives(SLO) and intermediate milestones leading up to it
    • Interlock with Executive Sponsors to help resolve roadblocks in a timely manner
  • Communication and Reporting
    • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales, support, product teams and other invested parties
    • Effective use of dashboards and keen understanding of how to use data to help deliver the outcomes needed and track progress towards SLO
    • Set clear customer expectations and ensure timely updates on troubleshooting and resolution action plans for internal and customer facing communications
  • Risk Management
    • Make informed decisions on elevating urgency and apply relevant focus to solve for a situation with right governance, guardrails and reviews in place
    • A “whatever it takes” customer-first attitude and a willingness to go the extra mile to foster customer success
    • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Retrospective and Preventive Measures
    • Retrospectives and PostMortem to help improve the process/system/product
    • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and/or processes and drive actions to prevent future problems
    • Recognitions and reporting on problem areas which will give insight to the magnitude of the issue through the amount of cases or number of customers impacted or related to these areas
    • Understanding of techniques to predict risks using data and AI models and systematic approach to address
    • Co-create and pilot proactive programs to reduce likelihood of customer and field escalations
Qualifications
Your Experience
  • Fully fluent in Portuguese, English, and Spanish both written and verbal
  • Customer Experience
    • 10+ years of customer-facing sales and/or service delivery roles
    • Past experience as Escalations Engineer/Manager, Technical Account Management, Engineering Management, Customer Support Management, or similar roles desired
    • Customer centric attitude and focus on providing best-in-class service for customers and collaborators
  • Program/Project management
    • Manage critical issues in a cross-functional environment that includes working with support, customer success, professional services, sales, customers, and partners to resolve complex and critical issues
    • Ability to multitask and prioritize with a goal of driving issues to closure on behalf of the customer
    • Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Asana, Tableau, JIRA and experience in running and operating with the SLA/SLO/Milestones paradigm and clarity on what success and corresponding metrics looks like
  • Collaboration and Influence
    • Strong capacity for Influencing, negotiating, and delegating efforts
    • Ability to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment with global customers
  • Leadership and communication skills
    • Experience in being able to effectively lead and motivate a team of cross functional professionals
    • Expertise in communicating complex topics in a clear and concise manner to different tiers of audiences(highly technical, less technical, executives, practitioners)
  • Technical skills
    • Experience with Networking/Security Products
    • Knowledge of LAN/WAN technologies, encompassing general routing/switching/security for both branch and data center architectures
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales teams, and other invested parties
  • Creative thinking, adaptability, and versatility
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Strong ability to influence and effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and/or processes and drive actions to prevent future issues
Additional Information
The Team
The Escalation Managers are part of the Global Incident and Escalation Management team which part of Global Customer Support and Service teams covering all Palo Alto offerings of cybersecurity platforms and solutions.
Team is responsible for driving expedited response, remedy, resolution, and learnings for our most critical issues. Escalation Managers(EM) team ensures focused technical leadership, effective coordination and communication, and streamlined decision-making
As Escalation Managers, each team member will be at the vanguard of our dedication to cybersecurity. Addressing the most pressing situations for our customers, you will hold a central position in solidifying our reputation as the go-to cybersecurity partner. This role demands proactivity, efficiency, an unwavering dedication to constant refinement, and a passion for customer satisfaction.
Driving continuous learnings and efficiency into the Escalation Management and Product Lifecycle is one of the key areas for the team as we continue our focus on customer experience.
Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Marketing Coordinator
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right.

Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a motivated, ambitious Marketing Coordinator to join our growing team!


Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Running a company is a little like building a plane while flying it. There’s always too much to do; doing one thing means neglecting something else. You have to blog but also be active on social media. You have to build websites and then optimize them for mobile. Email lists. Emails. Keywords. SEM. SEO. UX. UI. FML. OMG. That’s where we come in. We provide an unlimited get-shit-done subscription for our clients. And we need your help!


About You


  • Highly motivated and passionate about delivering excellent work
  • Proactive, always anticipating potential challenges and crafting solutions
  • Strong communicator, ensuring clarity with both internal teams and clients
  • Professional level of English (written and spoken)
  • Friendly, respectful, and able to work effectively within a team
  • Detail-oriented, organized, and resourceful—you find answers when needed and make sure things are running smoothly
  • You’re a people person and love finding ways to solve problems with creative ideas
  • Excellent time management and ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously
  • You love talking through ideas, offering feedback, and helping teams align with client goals
  • A background in marketing is essential
  • Nerdiness is a bonus! If you love D&D, Pokémon, video games, or books, we’ll get along just fine!


Purpose of the Role


The Marketing Coordinator role combines project coordination with client relationship management, acting as a bridge between internal teams and clients. This role supports smooth project execution by managing internal communication, task coordination, and ensuring that all client deliverables are met on time, within budget, and to the highest standard. You'll be integral in managing both the marketing efforts and client interactions, translating client goals into actionable tasks, and ensuring the process runs seamlessly from start to finish.


Main Objectives


1-Client Collaboration & Project Oversight:

  • Collaborate with clients to understand their marketing goals and expectations.
  • Translate these goals into clear tasks for the Marketing Coordinator, ensuring smooth project execution.
  • Regularly meet with clients to review deliverables, adjust timelines, and maintain strong relationships.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, providing updates, addressing concerns, and ensuring satisfaction.


2-Internal Team Coordination:

  • Work closely with designers, copywriters, media buyers, and other team members to develop high-quality marketing materials across all service offerings.
  • Organize internal kick-off meetings, assign tasks, and ensure that everything stays on schedule and within scope.
  • Provide clear direction and thoughtful feedback to internal teams to ensure work meets or exceeds client expectations.
  • Ensure all project management tools (Asana, Trello, ClickUp) and Teamwork boards are up to date.


3-Communication & Task Management:

  • Manage meetings with clients, ensuring clear action plans and next steps.
  • Review and approve final deliverables before submission, making sure they meet client goals and expectations.
  • Use tools like Jiminny to document meetings, share important notes, and ensure all action items are tracked.
  • Keep all teams aligned through regular check-ins and updates, making sure deadlines are met and no tasks fall through the cracks.


4-Resource Planning & Problem Solving:

  • Manage multiple projects at once, ensuring each one is progressing smoothly, with no delays or miscommunication.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues, whether they relate to resources, deadlines, or client feedback.
  • Proactively anticipate problems and find creative solutions to keep projects on track.


5-Strategic & Process-Oriented Thinking:

  • Help shape the big-picture marketing strategy with the Senior Account Manager.
  • Continuously look for ways to improve internal workflows, ensuring efficiency and consistent delivery.
  • Build strong, positive relationships both within the team and with clients, helping to drive long-term success.


Additional Skills

  • Project Management: Skilled at managing timelines and juggling multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Verbal & Written Communication: Excellent communication skills—both internally and with clients.
  • Emotional Intelligence: Able to handle complex client personalities and stay calm under pressure.
  • Time Management: Proficient in balancing meetings, internal work, and client deliverables without missing a beat.
  • Presentation Skills: Comfortable leading client meetings and representing the agency confidently.


Our operating hours are from 9 am to 5 pm MST, Monday to Friday.

Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now—let’s get talking, get making, and go get that bacon.

title: Líder técnico
description:
Faça parte de uma das maiores empresas de serviços de TI do mundo! Aqui você transforma a sua carreira!


Por que entrar na TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, é por isso que vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado, cheia de oportunidades de melhoria, e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para o nosso sucesso em um ambiente colaborativo.


Estamos procurando por Analista Funcional - Líder Técnico , que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira, em modalidade CLT, híbrida , na cidade de São Paulo .


Nessa posição você irá: atuar em projetos de alta complexidade, liderando tecnicamente equipes e garantindo a entrega de soluções inovadoras e alinhadas às melhores práticas do mercado.


  • Participar de projetos de alta complexidade, conduzindo reuniões e definindo soluções.
  • Liderar tecnicamente analistas;
  • Realizar entrevistas, mapeamento de processos e licitação de requisitos.
  • Elaborar documentação funcional, técnica e plano de projeto.
  • Garantir atualização das documentações e acompanhar cronogramas.
  • Orientar o time de desenvolvimento conforme a solução definida.
  • Validar entregas, garantindo qualidade e conformidade.
  • Conduzir reuniões de status report, negociações de escopo e prazos.
  • Atuar na implantação/migração de sistemas e acompanhar operação assistida.
  • Propor inovações baseadas em melhores práticas de processos e aplicações.


Habilidades esperadas:
